title: Farmslot Gateway recipe RPC and artifact package smoke
description: Validates recipe-run RPCs, artifact index ingestion, run/family projection, and manifest contract without requiring visual replay.

list-recipe-runs.intent: Request run.recipeRunsForRun and verify the gateway returns current, attempted, and promoted recipe-run groups when available.

open-artifact-index.intent: Open a typed recipe-run artifact through the /api/run-artifact route with the selected recipeRunId preserved.

validate-manifest-package.cmd: cd apps/command-center && yarn farmslot recipe validate ../../../docs/examples/recipes/farmslot/gateway-rpc-api.recipe.json --artifact-dir ../../docs/examples/recipes/farmslot/artifacts/gateway-rpc-api
validate-manifest-package.intent: Run the shared v1 contract validator against the recipe and artifact package returned by the gateway.

assert-family-projection.intent: Verify run/family observability can project recipe-run artifact groups without mixing PR feedback artifacts into recipe evidence.

index-artifacts.intent: Publish gateway RPC transcript, manifest validation output, summary, trace, and resolved recipe.
